unauthorized.when: A missing, invalid, expired or revoked credential.

forbiddenScope.when: A token without an explicit feeds:read.

notFound.when: An unknown, another account's, a deleted or an article feed; rich feeds off for the account; a malformed ref; a thread the upstream does not have; or a thread whose post a page would not serve now.

notAcceptable.when: The owner sent anything but the rich Accept.

rateLimited.when: Past the feed read limit it shares with pages and grants.

sourceUnavailable.when: The upstream failed, redirected, timed out or sent an invalid thread.

body.error: Feeds are not configured on this server

notConfigured.when: The server has no public origin.
